notes.title: Copies of copies
notes.science: A message passed from hand to hand changes a little at each step. Odd details fade, and familiar ones grow.
notes.limits: A sketch game is only a picture of this.
notes.counter: Some messages hold steady when people care about them.
notes.question: Which detail lasted longest?

sources.label: Transmission Chain Studies of Cultural Evolution, Mesoudi and Whiten, 2008
Iterated Learning, Kalish, Griffiths and Lewandowsky, 2007

notes.title: Memory rebuilds
notes.science: Remembering rebuilds a story from parts, so each telling can add something new.
notes.limits: The sketch game has no memory, only hands.
notes.counter: Some memories stay sharp for years.
notes.question: What did you add without meaning to?
